PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 460
PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 460
CHILDREN LIBRARY COMPLEX, LAHORE EMPLOYEES
(APPOINTMENT, TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF
SERVICE) REGULATIONS, 2022
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
2nd March, 2023]
No.
CLC/AO35-I/2019/1185, dated 10.2.2023.---In exercise of the powers conferred under section 18 of the Punjab
Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960 (XI of 1960),
the Board, with the approval of Government, is pleased to make the following
regulations:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
These regulations may be cited as the Children Library Complex, Lahore
Employees (Appointment, Terms and Conditions of Service) Regulations, 2022.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In the regulations, unless the context or
subject requires otherwise:
(a) "appointing
authority" means an authority as reflected in column 4 of the Schedule;
(b) "Board"
means the Board of Governors of Children Library Complex, Lahore constituted
under section 4 of the Ordinance;
(c) "competent
authority" means the appointing authority of a post;
(d) "Complex"
means the Children Library Complex, Lahore including its branches;
(e) "duty"
means the duty assigned by the Board;
(f) "employee"
means a person who has been employed against a regular vacancy in the Complex
and includes Government servants transferred to the Service;
(g) "leave"
means the leave as given in Chapter-IV of the regulations;
(h) "Managing
Director" means the Managing Director of the Complex;
(i) "Ordinance"
means the Punjab Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance,
1960 (XI of 1960);
(j) "promotion
committee" means the promotion committee constituted under section 8 of
the Ordinance;
(k) "pay
and allowances" means the pay and allowances as given in Chapter-III of
the regulations;
(l) "post"
means a post as reflected in column 3 of the Schedule;
(m) "regulations"
means the Children Library Complex, Lahore Employees (Appointment, Terms and
Conditions of Service) Regulations, 2022;
(n) "scale
of pay" means the scale as reflected in column 3 of the Schedule;
(o) "Schedule"
means a Schedule appended to the regulations;
(p) "scrutiny
committee" means a scrutiny committee, constituted under section 8 of the
Ordinance;
(q) "selection
committee" means a committee constituted under section 8 of the Ordinance;
and
(r) "Service"
means the service of the Complex and Board.
(2) A
word or expression used but not defined in the regulations shall have the same
meaning as assigned to it in the Ordinance and the rules framed thereunder.
CHAPTER-II
APPOINTMENT AND TERMS AND CONDITIONS
OF SERVICE
3. Nomenclature,
terms and conditions of a post.---The
nomenclature of a post, appointing authority, its scale of pay, minimum
qualification and experience, method of recruitment, minimum and maximum age
limit and mode of appointment shall be such as given in the Schedule.
4. Procedure
of appointment against a post.---(1)
For an appointment, other than by promotion, the Deputy Director shall, after
approval of the competent authority, advertise the post in at least two
national dailies, one in English and one in Urdu, having wide circulation and
on the website of the Complex.
(2) The
advertisement shall contain number of vacancies, nomenclature of a post, its
scale of pay, minimum and maximum age, minimum qualification and experience,
mode of appointment and closing date for receipt of applications, which shall
not be less than fifteen days from the date of its publication.
(3) The
Deputy Director shall prepare a list containing names and father or husband
names of applicants for each post and upload on the official website of the
Complex within five working days from the closing date.
(4) The
Deputy Director shall, after receipt of applications, prepare a list of the
applicants on the basis of qualification and experience, as early as possible,
but not later than thirty working days from the closing date.
